Summary: 9 requirements reviewed: 6 with issues, 3 without. 5 issues found (1 High, 3 Medium, 1 Low). Types: Vague_Language (1), Incomplete_Requirement (1), Untestable_Requirement (1), Ambiguous_Statement (1), Internal_Contradiction (1).

RequirementReviews.RequirementStatement: REQ-1: The search page shall be user-friendly and return results within 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
REQ-2: The system shall lock an account after 3 consecutive failed login attempts.
REQ-3: The system shall send a notification when an order is delayed.
REQ-4: The service shall be available 100% of the time.
REQ-5: The system shall process refunds within 5 days.
REQ-6: Invoices shall be payable within 30 days of the issue date.
REQ-7: Invoices shall be payable within 14 days of the issue date.
REQ-8: The export job shall complete within 10 minutes for 99% of runs with up to 50 concurrent exports.
REQ-9: Closed support tickets shall be retained for 5 years and shall not be editable by agents.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-1: The search page shall be user-friendly and return results within 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The term 'user-friendly' has no objective interpretation, so that clause cannot be verified. The 2-second clause is measurable and is not affected.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Replace 'user-friendly' with objectively verifiable usability criteria agreed with the stakeholders.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-3: The system shall send a notification when an order is delayed.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The document does not define when an order counts as delayed, so the notification trigger cannot be implemented or verified consistently.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define the condition that makes an order delayed and who receives the notification.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-4: The service shall be available 100% of the time.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: An absolute availability guarantee with no bounded measurement period or allowed downtime cannot be objectively verified.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Restate the availability expectation as a bounded, measurable target with a defined measurement period.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-5: The system shall process refunds within 5 days.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: 'Within 5 days' can mean calendar or business days, and it is unclear which event starts the period, so two materially different readings are possible.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: State whether the period uses calendar or business days and which event starts it.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-6: Invoices shall be payable within 30 days of the issue date.
IssuesIdentified.RelatedEvidence: REQ-7: Invoices shall be payable within 14 days of the issue date.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The two statements give different payment periods for the same invoices, so both cannot be satisfied.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Resolve which payment period applies with the stakeholders and remove or correct the conflicting statement.
